sources.quote: QS-C-2025,SUP-C,conditional,2025-04-01,,PER-BIANCHI,QS-C-2023,no new parts until 8D-25-031 is closed and re-audit passed
4.3 A supplier with status conditional may not receive new parts.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone's current status (QS-C-2025, which replaces the approved QS-C-2023) is conditional. BR-220 would be a new part for them, so they may not receive it.

sources.quote: APR-001,SUP-B,BR-220,PLT-BEI,CUST-AUR,approved,2024-02-10,,PER-BIANCHI,

4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
Approved blank source: Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B), single source.

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers BR-220 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR and lists only SUP-B. There is no entry for Meccanica Chisone, so it has no approval for this part, plant and customer.

sources.quote: BR-220,"Front subframe bracket, milled",PRG-X,C,MAT-6082-T6,COAT-ANOD,SC-BR220-YS
PRG-X,Aurelia Torre compact SUV,CUST-AUR,MKT-EU,2025-02-01

7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source

no change to an
approved part or its process may be implemented without the written approval of Aurelia.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual (it replaces revision 3) requires written PPAP approval and 90 days' notice for a change of source. No Aurelia approval is on file for this change, and the rejected DEV-127 was not one.

sources.quote: 8D report 8D-25-031. Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.

cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier
Material: EN AW-6082-T6.

findings.why: Chisone has an open 8D on cracking in EN AW-6082 material, and BR-220 is made of EN AW-6082-T6. The 8D is still open, and the root cause is under investigation (suspected inconsistent ageing). The FMEA names this failure mode as severity 9.

sources.quote: BR-220,"Front subframe bracket, milled",PRG-X,C,MAT-6082-T6,COAT-ANOD,SC-BR220-YS

they can make BR-220 blanks from the same alloy they use for
BR-310
Not interchangeable with EN AW-6061: different alloy, lower yield.

findings.why: The drawing requires EN AW-6082-T6 (SC-BR220-YS needs yield of at least 250 MPa). Chisone is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. The 6082-T5 material that BR-310 uses has a typical yield of 230 MPa, which is below 250. Saying it is "the same alloy" ignores the temper.

sources.quote: Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: A change of source needs a 3.1 certificate from the new supplier for the drawing material, MAT-6082-T6. Chisone has certificates only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. Owner: the supplier quality engineer, Elena Gallo.
